title: The Fixed rules tab label has one space before the count
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Admin at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919), with the Settings - Parts permission.
  • {Location-A} has a small number of fixed rules that you can count on screen (for example 6).
  • Category {Category-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PC48 cat) exists.
  • Inventory part {Part-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PC48-1) is at {Location-A} in {Category-A} and has no fixed price yet.
  • The Pricing Search box is empty, so every fixed rule is listed.
custom_steps:
1. Go to Settings and click Pricing in the Parts group of the Settings menu.
  2. Click the Fixed rules tab.
  3. Wait until the loading indicator on the Fixed rules tab disappears.
  4. Read the Fixed rules tab label exactly, including the space before the bracket.
  5. Count the rows in the Fixed rules list.
  6. Click Add Fixed Rule.
  7. Choose {Part-A}.
  8. Enter a fixed price (for example 15.00).
  9. Save the dialog.
  10. Wait until the loading indicator on the Fixed rules tab disappears.
  11. Read the Fixed rules tab label again.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 4: the label reads Fixed rules (N), with exactly one space between the word and the opening bracket. It may be shown in capitals (Fixed Rules (N)); that is expected and is not a defect.
  • Step 5: N equals the number of rows you counted (for example 6 rows and the label reads Fixed rules (6)).
  • Step 11: N is one more than in step 4 (for example 6 + 1 = 7, so the label reads Fixed rules (7)), still with one space before the bracket.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-11258; story SV-10136 (Story 3, Fixed Rules, sortable columns; story text re-synced to the PRD on 13 Oct 2026); PRD "Settings Pricing And Categories Sorting (Price/Category)", Confluence 578781186, version 21 (14 Oct 2026), S3-R15, S3-R16, S3-R17, §2 Tab labels, read 14 Oct 2026; design canvas board 1.4 (Fixed rules - before and after), 13 Oct copy, unchanged on 14 Oct.
